title.en: An Act to Amend Items Nineteen and Twenty, aa. La Union, Paragraph I, Title B, of Section One of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Two Hundred

text.en:
Items nineteen and twenty, aa. La Union, paragraph I, title B, of section one Republic Act Numbered One thousand two hundred, are amended to read as follows:
"(19) Leones-Macalva Tubao-Agoo-Completion ₱8,000.00 "(20) Sta. Teresa Road, Tubao-Completion 5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
